notes: 10 MetaRoad passive base descriptions. Each displays one variant, but variant-level source verification and overall class completeness are not claimed.

skills.name: Enhance Health
skills.summary: Increases HP by 250, Max HP by 7.5%, and Incoming Heal by 6%.

skills.name: Warding Shield
skills.summary: Increases Block by 200; restores 53–64 HP on Block. Internal cooldown 3s.

skills.name: Punishing Benediction
skills.summary: Increases Critical Hit by 100; attacks grant a 10s buff with 50% chance of 38% ATK + 69 bonus damage on hit. Internal cooldown 1s.

skills.name: Ironclad Defense
skills.summary: Increases Defense by 7% and Endurance by 1%.

skills.name: Guarding Seal
skills.summary: At 50% HP or lower grants a shield worth 21% Max HP for 30s. Cooldown 60s.

skills.name: Impact Hit
skills.summary: Increases Impact-type Chance by 11.2% and Double Chance by 0.3%.

skills.name: Insulting Roar
skills.summary: Increases Enmity Boost by 100%; Front Attack grants 5.5% Attack for 5s. Cooldown 5s.

skills.name: Fury
skills.summary: Increases Front Attack Damage Boost by 0.3%; on Block grants party 5.5% PvE and 2.75% PvP Damage Boost for 20s. Cooldown 1s.

skills.name: Survival Willpower
skills.summary: Increases Status Effect Resist by 17%; crowd-control triggers 12% PvE and 6% PvP Damage Tolerance for 5s; repeated hits while controlled grant stacking Status Effect Resist.

skills.name: Block Pain
skills.summary: On being hit grants 11% PvE and 5.5% PvP Damage Tolerance for 10s. Cooldown 20s.
